To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the negative feedback in the regulation of the photosynthetic reactions results in a non-linear photosyn- thesis response to light.

the photosynthetic activity of plants and cyanobacterium is modulated by negative feedback regulation and that this regulation is the origin of the observed non-linearities in the response of the photosynthetic system.
the negative feedback of photosynthesis is responsible for the appearance of upper harmonics in the response of photosynthesis to a dynamic light.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis and modelling of the non-linear response of the photosynthetic apparatus to dynamic light conditions, with a focus on the negative feedback regulation.
the elucidation of the regulatory processes in photosynthesis that are responsible for the non-linearity of photosynthesis in a dynamic light environment.
the non-linear response of the photosynthetic apparatus of plants and cyanobacterial cells to a harmonically modulating light.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the non-linear photosynthesis is the result of the negative feedback regulation that can be observed in the light response curve and in the kinetics of photosynthesis.

the non-linear modulation is a general feature of the photosynthetic system and that it is the result of the regulatory processes that are essential for the adaptation of photosynthesis to a dynamic light regime.
the non-linear modulation is a result of a negative feedback regulation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
negative feedback regulation of PSII and Calvin-Benson reactions is a common feature in plants and cyanbacteria.
the observed non-linearity of photosynthetic response is caused by the negative feedback regulation.
the non-linear photosynthesis is an intrinsic property of photosynthetic organisms and it is not an artifact of the experimental conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

negative feedback regulation is responsible not only for the non-linear response of the steady-state photosynthetic activity to the incident irradiance but also for the non-linear transients in the photosynthetic activities.
negative feedback regulation of chloroplast metabolism is a general phenomenon and is likely to be relevant in the natural light environment.

the negative feedbacks can result in the appearance of the upper harmonic components in the photosynthetic response, and the frequency of the upper harmonic modes can be used to infer the time constant of the feedback regulation.
